title: Case REQ-20261109-LIF003 — referral and business details
content:
Referral and business details captured by the Onboarding Agent for Olivia (Onboarding & Requests) on Mon 9 Nov 2026. Case REQ-20261109-LIF003 · request type Business protection advice · adviser Amelia, Senior Risk Adviser · referred by Marcus Tan, Bayside Business Accountants.

Referral: Marcus Tan, accountant, Bayside Business Accountants (marcus.tan@baysideaccountants.example.com.au), referred the owners of Northcote Custom Joinery on 9 Nov 2026 because they have no succession plan.

Business: Northcote Custom Joinery Pty Ltd — founded 2011; 14 staff; revenue $3.1 million; net profit $520,000. Valued at $2,400,000 by Marcus at 30 Jun 2026 (see 'Case REQ-20261109-LIF003 — valuation summary'). Owned 50/50 by:
• George Papadopoulos, 52 (DOB 19/04/1974) — master joiner and co-founder (50%); lives in Thornbury VIC with his wife Helen. Client number CL-104611. george@northcotejoinery.example.com.au, 0491 570 158.
• Harpreet Kaur, 47 (DOB 08/09/1979) — operations and finance director (50%). Client number CL-104612.

What the owners want: if either of them dies or becomes totally and permanently disabled, the other can buy their 50% share and the departing owner or their family receives a fair value; and the company is protected if it loses George, whose skills drive production.

In-good-order checklist:
✅ Financial Services Guide given
✅ privacy and health-information consent signed by George and Harpreet
✅ company extract and ID for both beneficial owners sent to Financial Crime for KYC
✅ authority for Marcus to share the valuation and two years' company financial statements
✅ consent to update Marcus on the outcome, with no health details
⚠️ buy-sell agreement to be drafted by the owners' lawyer (Life Advice Guru doesn't draft legal documents)
⚠️ total cover is likely to be $2,000,000 or more, so the advice needs Theo's second review

Priority: Standard.

Routing: Financial Crime (KYC on the company and both owners) → Paraplanning (needs analysis) → Insurance Research → Team Leader Office (second review) → Underwriting & New Business → Client Communications.
